lines.text: Mephibosheth meets the king and says he is lame and his servant Ziba deceived him.
David declares that Mephibosheth and Ziba will divide the land, and Mephibosheth answers, "Let Ziba take it all."
Barzillai the Gileadite, eighty years old and very wealthy, provided for the king while he stayed in Hebron.
Barzillai asks to die near his parents' tomb and offers Joab instead, and the king blesses him.
Israel complains that Judah took the king across secretly, and Judah answers that the king is their relative.
